--diseaseType.label: DISEASE TYPE
--diseaseType.help: Disease Type, e.g. 'adnexal and skin appendage neoplasms'

--aligner.label: ALIGNER
--aligner.help: Reference to mapping/alignment software. Example bwa-0.7.8

--analysisDate.label: ANALYSIS DATE
--analysisDate.help: Date at which analysis was performed. Example 2021-10-17

--biosampleId.label: BIOSAMPLE ID
--biosampleId.help: Reference to the id of the biosample this analysis is reporting on. Example S0001

--identification.label: ID
--identification.help: Analysis reference ID (external accession or internal ID). Example GA.01234abcde

--individualId.label: INDIVIDUALID
--individualId.help: Reference to the id of the individual this analysis is reporting on. Example P0001

--pipelineName.label: PIPELINE NAME
--pipelineName.help: Analysis pipeline and version if a standardized pipeline was used. Example Pipeline-panel-0001-v1

--runId.label: RUNID
--runId.help: Run identifier (external accession or internal ID). Example SRR10903401

--variantCaller.label: VARIANT CALLER
--variantCaller.help: Reference to variant calling software / pipeline. Example GATK4.0

--biosampleStatus.label: BIOSAMPLE STATUS
--biosampleStatus.help: Ontology value for the classification of the sample in abnormal sample (EFO:0009655) or reference sample (EFO:0009654)

--collectionDate.label: COLLECTION DATE
--collectionDate.help: Date of biosample collection in ISO8601 format

--collectionMoment.label: COLLECTION MOMENT
--collectionMoment.help: Individual's or cell culture age at the time of sample collection in the ISO8601 duration format P[n]Y[n]M[n]DT[n]H[n]M[n]S, e.g. P32Y6M1D, P7D

--identification.label: ID
--identification.help: Biosample identifier (external accession or internal ID)

--diagnosticMarkers.label: DIAGNOSTIC MARKERS
--diagnosticMarkers.help: Clinically relevant bio markers, e.g. T2b Stage Finding

--histologicalDiagnosis.label: HISTOLOGICAL DIAGNOSIS
--histologicalDiagnosis.help: Disease diagnosis that was inferred from the histological examination, e.g. Serous Cystadenocarcinoma

--obtentionProcedure.label: OBTENTION PROCEDURE
--obtentionProcedure.help: Ontology value describing the procedure for sample obtention, e.g. biopsy

--pathologicalStage.label: PATHOLOGICAL STAGE
--pathologicalStage.help: Pathological stage, if applicable, e.g. Stage IIIA

--featureType.label: FEATURE TYPE
--featureType.help: Definition of an ontology term which describes the phenotype, e.g. Infantile spasms

--severity.label: SEVERITY
--severity.help: Ontology class that describes the severity of the condition, e.g. Moderate

--sampleOriginDetail.label: SAMPLE ORIGIN DETAIL
--sampleOriginDetail.help: Tissue from which the sample was taken or sample origin matching the category set in 'sampleOriginType', e.g. wall of urinary bladder

--sampleOriginType.label: SAMPLE ORIGIN TYPE
--sampleOriginType.help: Category of sample origin. Value from Ontology for Biomedical Investigations (OBI) material entity, e.g abnormal sample

--sampleProcessing.label: SAMPLE PROCESSING
--sampleProcessing.help: Status of how the specimen was processed, e.g. mechanical dissociation

--sampleStorage.label: SAMPLE STORAGE
--sampleStorage.help: Status of how the specimen was stored

--tumorGrade.label: TUMOR GRADE
--tumorGrade.help: Term representing the tumor grade, e.g. Grade 3a

--tumorProgression.label: TUMOR PROGRESSION
--tumorProgression.help: Tumor progression category indicating primary, metastatic or recurrent progression, e.g. Primary Malignant Neoplasm

--cohortDataTypes.label: COHORTDATA TYPES
--cohortDataTypes.help: The type of data chorort, e.g. clinical history

--cohortDesign.label: COHORTDESIGN
--cohortDesign.help: A plan specification comprised of protocols that are executed as part of an investigation, e.g. longitudinal study design

--cohortSize.label: COHORT SIZE
--cohortSize.help: Count of unique Individuals in cohort

--cohortType.label: COHORT TYPE
--cohortType.help: Cohort type by its definition, e.g. study-defined

--dataUseConditions.label: DATAUSECONDITIONS
--dataUseConditions.help: Data use conditions applying to this dataset, e.g. disease specific research

--ontologyModifiers.label: DATA USE CONDITIONS MODIFIERS
--ontologyModifiers.help: Modifiers that further specify the datasets, e.g. coronary artery disease

--ageGroup.label: AGE GROUP
--ageGroup.help: age af onset, e.g. Adult 18-65 Years Old

--individualId.label: INDIVIDUAL ID
--individualId.help: Reference to the individual ID, e.g. TCGA-AO-A0JJ

--libraryLayout.label: LIBRARY LAYOUT
--libraryLayout.help: Ontology value for the library layout e.g 'PAIRED', 'SINGLE'

--librarySelection.label: LIBRARY SELECTION
--librarySelection.help: Selection method for library preparation, e.g 'RANDOM', 'RT-PCR'

--librarySource.label: LIBRARY SOURCE
--librarySource.help: Ontology value for the source of the sequencing or hybridization library, e.g 'genomic source', 'transcriptomic source'

--platform.label: PLATFORM
--platform.help: General platform technology label where the specific model is not relevant, e.g. Illumina

--platformModel.label: PLATFORM MODEL
--platformModel.help: Ontology value for experimental platform or methodology used, e.g. 'Illumina HiSeq 3000'

--runDate.label: RUN DATE
--runDate.help: Date at which the experiment was performed
